name: imhotep-mcp

tools.name: imhotep_list_projects
tools.description: Locate or enumerate Imhotep Projects by name fragment and/or status (Planning/Active/Completed). A pasted Id or record URL fetches that Project directly. The Project is the top of the hierarchy — most work starts here.

query.description: Optional name fragment, or a pasted Salesforce Id / record URL to fetch directly.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_get_project
tools.description: Open one Imhotep Project (core fields + point/count rollups). Accepts a name fragment, Id, or record URL. Use `include` to also pull "releases" and/or "resources" (Resource Links).

project.description: The Project to open: name fragment, Id, or record URL.

include.description: Related data to pull: "releases", "resources". Omit to use the configured defaults.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_list_releases
tools.description: List a Project's Releases (points goal/remaining, dates, backlog flag). Filter by status or set is_backlog=true for the backlog Release(s). The Project accepts a name, Id, or URL.

project.description: The Project whose Releases to list: name fragment, Id, or record URL. Defaults to the configured defaultImhotepProject when omitted.

is_backlog.description: When true, return only the backlog Release(s) for the Project.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_get_release
tools.description: Open one Imhotep Release (fields, points rollups, Release Notes as Markdown). Accepts a name fragment, Id, or record URL. Use `include: ["stories"]` to also pull its Stories.

release.description: The Release to open: name fragment, Id, or record URL.

include.description: Related data to pull: "stories". Omit to use the configured defaults.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_get_story
tools.description: Open one Imhotep Story. Accepts a Story number (e.g. "528", "S000528"), an 18/15-char Salesforce Id, a pasted record URL, or a Title fragment. Use `include` for "bodies" (rich-text as Markdown), "children" (child Stories), and "tags" (all on by default). On an ambiguous or missing reference, returns candidate Stories rather than an error.

story.description: The Story to open: a Story number (e.g. "528", "S000528"), an 18/15-char Salesforce Id, a pasted record URL, or a Title fragment.

include.description: Related data to pull: "bodies" (rich-text fields as Markdown), "children" (child Stories), "tags". Omit to use the configured defaults (all three on by default).

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target (overrides configured default).

tools.name: imhotep_list_stories
tools.description: The workhorse Story list ("what's in flight", "stories in release X"). Filters (release, project, status, type, assigned_to, parent_story, tag) are AND-combined; results are skinny (no rich-text bodies), ordered by priority then Story number. release/project/parent_story accept a name, number, Id, or URL.

release.description: Filter to a Release (name, Id, or URL).

project.description: Filter to a Project (name, Id, or URL).

assigned_to.description: Filter by the Assigned Project Member Id.

parent_story.description: Filter to children of this parent Story (number, Id, or URL).

tag.description: Filter to Stories carrying this Tag (Tag Id).

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_search
tools.description: Free-text search across an object's Name and body fields when you have no number or exact name. Choose object = Story (default), Project, or Release. Returns skinny matches to pick from.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_create_story
tools.description: Create a Story under a Release. The Project is derived automatically from the Release (you do not pass it). Set parent_story to create a child Story. Rich-text fields (description, acceptance_criteria, build_notes, deployment_checklist) are authored in Markdown. Returns the new Story (with its SNNNNNN number). Preview the payload + target org and get user approval before calling.

release.description: The Release to create the Story under (name, Id, or URL). Defaults to the configured currentImhotepRelease when omitted.

title.description: The Story title (the Name field). Max 80 characters.

parent_story.description: Parent Story (number, Id, or URL) — set to create a child Story.

record_type.description: Record type (defaults to the configured default, normally Standard).

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_update_story
tools.description: Update one or more writable fields on a Story, including status (e.g. "mark S000528 Ready"). Rich-text fields are authored in Markdown. System-maintained fields are refused. Preview the change + target org and get user approval before calling.

story.description: The Story to update: number, Id, URL, or title fragment.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_transfer_story
tools.description: Move a Story to another Release. The Story's Project is kept consistent automatically (re-pointed to the destination Release's Project). "Move to backlog" = transfer to the backlog Release. Preview + get user approval before calling.

story.description: The Story to move: number, Id, URL, or title fragment.

to_release.description: The destination Release (name, Id, or URL). For "move to backlog", use the backlog Release.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_update_release
tools.description: Update writable Release fields (status, dates, points goal, backlog flag, description, and Release Notes — Markdown → HTML). System-maintained rollup fields are refused. Preview + get user approval before calling.

release.description: The Release to update: name, Id, or URL.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_create_stories
tools.description: Create 1–200 Stories in one all-or-nothing call — e.g. all the Stories for a signed-off build plan. `defaults` (release, type, status, record_type, parent_story) apply to every item unless the item sets its own; each Project is derived from its Release. Parent Stories must already exist. If any item fails, nothing is created and every failure is returned by index. Returns the new Stories (skinny, with SNNNNNN numbers) in input order. Preview the full batch + target org and get user approval before calling.

title.description: The Story title (the Name field). Max 80 characters.

release.description: Release for this Story (name, Id, or URL). Overrides defaults.release.

parent_story.description: Existing parent Story (number, Id, or URL). Overrides defaults.parent_story. Must already exist — it cannot be a Story created in this same batch.

stories.description: The Stories to create (1–200), returned in this order.

release.description: Release for every Story (name, Id, or URL). Falls back to the configured currentImhotepRelease when omitted.

record_type.description: Record type for every Story (default: the configured default, normally Standard).

parent_story.description: Existing parent Story (number, Id, or URL) for every Story.

defaults.description: Values applied to every item unless the item sets its own.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_update_stories
tools.description: Update writable fields on 1–200 Stories in one all-or-nothing call (e.g. "mark these five Ready"). Each item names a Story by number, Id, or URL (no title fragments) plus only the fields to change; rich-text fields are Markdown and overwrite the whole field. If any item fails, nothing is saved. Preview the full batch + target org and get user approval before calling.

story.description: The Story to update: Story number (e.g. S000528), Id, or record URL.

stories.description: The Stories to update (1–200), each with only the fields to change. Each Story may appear once.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_transfer_stories
tools.description: Move 1–200 Stories to another Release in one all-or-nothing call (e.g. "move these to the backlog"). A top-level to_release applies to every item unless the item names its own; each Story's Project is kept consistent automatically. Stories are named by number, Id, or URL. If any item fails, nothing is moved. Preview + get user approval before calling.

story.description: The Story to move: Story number (e.g. S000528), Id, or record URL.

to_release.description: Destination Release for this Story (name, Id, or URL). Overrides to_release.

stories.description: The Stories to move (1–200). Each Story may appear once.

to_release.description: Destination Release for every Story (name, Id, or URL). For "move to backlog", use the backlog Release.

org.description: Optional Salesforce org alias/username to target.

tools.name: imhotep_get_config
tools.description: Show current Imhotep MCP settings: the merged effective config (default → global → project) or a single scope's raw contents ("default", "global", "project"). Read-only.

scope.description: Which config to show: "effective" (merged default→global→project, the default), or a single scope's raw contents ("default", "global", "project").

tools.name: imhotep_set_config
tools.description: Change a setting (defaultImhotepOrg, defaultImhotepProject, currentImhotepRelease, autonomousMode) at the global or project scope. Two-step: called without confirm=true it validates the value (resolving the org/project/release live) and returns a preview WITHOUT writing; call again with confirm=true to commit. Preview the change and get user approval before confirming.

value.description: The new value (boolean for autonomousMode/skillAutoInstall; string otherwise).

confirm.description: Set true to COMMIT. Without it, returns a validated preview and writes nothing.

tools.name: imhotep_init_config
tools.description: Scaffold a documented, commented starter imhotep.config.json at the "project" or "global" scope. No-clobber: refuses to overwrite an existing file.
